phases.name: Feasibility
phases.note: FEASIBILITY.md: Ladbrokes works from a GitHub runner, Betfair does not.
phases.gate: Know which sources can be read reliably from a GitHub Actions runner.

phases.name: Collection
phases.note: Cron runs were mostly dropped by GitHub (11 snapshots in 2 days). Replaced by a self-restarting loop on 11 Nov 2026.
phases.gate: Scheduled snapshot and results runs firing on every racing day, with early and late prices captured for most runners.

phases.name: Market diagnostics
phases.note: Market tests built, plus 10 forward tests that lock $1 picks before each jump. All below 300 races.
phases.gate: 300 settled races per code, a verdict on each test, and per-track results for all three tests.

phases.name: Market baseline
phases.note: Only raw 1 / O and overround exist. No power or Shin devigging.
phases.gate: Power and Shin devigging implemented and tested, with a reliability check of p_mkt against results.

phases.name: Benchmark
phases.note: Betfair SP files and logins are refused from GitHub-hosted runners.
phases.gate: Betfair SP captured for every race in scope, joined to our races by track, date and runner.

phases.name: Feature store
phases.note: Ladbrokes form (recent starts, weight, jockey, trainer, speed map, flags) captured before every jump from 11 Nov 2026. No sectionals or ratings.
phases.gate: A documented, permitted form source, and per-runner features stored for every settled race.

phases.name: Fundamental model
phases.gate: p_fund fitted on form features only, normalised within race, with no market data.

phases.name: Combination and calibration
phases.note: Needs p_fund, p_mkt and the Betfair SP benchmark.
phases.gate: Out-of-sample log loss better than de-vigged Betfair SP on a locked holdout, with reliability recorded.

phases.name: Staking
phases.note: Ledger uses flat $1 paper stakes inside the $100 weekly cap. No Kelly sizing.
phases.gate: Quarter Kelly off a $2,000 notional bank, joint sizing within a race, 2% per-bet cap and the weekly cap, all tested.

phases.name: Paper trading
phases.note: Paper ledger works, but the 3 picks so far were manual, not model picks.
phases.gate: 6 to 8 weeks of model-sized paper bets, then a recorded go / no-go decision against the backtest.

blockers: No Betfair SP capture, so there is no benchmark to measure any model against.
Collection is only proven once the new self-restarting loop has covered a full racing day.
Racing Queensland appears to render fields and start times via JavaScript, which an Actions runner may not be able to read. Ladbrokes now supplies basic form, but not speed or sectional ratings.
